## Change and coverage

Describe the methodology, required sources/mappings and any gaps.

- [ ] Released compiler validation and scripted episode pass locally.
- [ ] Expected answers are outside the installable package and model context.
- [ ] Sources and mappings exist in the current default IRMind build.
- [ ] Tools are minimal; coverage and false positives are explicit.
- [ ] Changed package content has a higher SemVer.
- [ ] Original text, MIT OR Apache-2.0; public references attributed.
- [ ] Synthetic data only; no real incidents, secrets, executable code or scripts.
- [ ] No instructions to bypass policy, request approvals or expand scope.
